## Core Products & Web Applications

### CogniitSearch
- **URL:** https://cogniitsearch.allkvd.dev/
- **Description:** AI-powered search platform with cited answers, multi-source retrieval, queue-backed background workers (14 concurrent jobs), and multi-layer Redis caching.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/kvdhanush06/CogniitSearch

### TermsGuard
- **URL:** https://termsguard.allkvd.dev/
- **Description:** Legal document analysis platform that summarizes lengthy Terms of Service and Privacy Policies into actionable risk assessments.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/kvdhanush06/TermsGuard

### AI Tools Directory
- **URL:** https://aitoolsdirectory.allkvd.dev/
- **Description:** Curated search directory platform for discovering and categorizing AI applications.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/kvdhanush06/ai-tools-directory

### EduToolsHub
- **URL:** https://edutoolshub.allkvd.dev/
- **Description:** Fault-tolerant workflow automation platform integrating 4 external service APIs with strict 5-second timeout boundaries and structured fallback schemas.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/kvdhanush06/EduToolsHub

### SociaSphere
- **URL:** https://sociasphere.allkvd.dev/
- **Description:** Distributed feed optimization engine & session service, optimizing relational queries from O(N) to O(1) single-query feeds.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/kvdhanush06/SociaSphere
